༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi rdzogs rim rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di la

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi rdzogs rim rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i mis rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ rgyud las| de nas rjes shes bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni// zhes pa nas/ rjes gsal chos kyi sku nyid 'grub par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar rkang pa nyi shu'i don gtan la dbab pa ste/ 'di skad du/ mchog gi go 'phang la mos pas// rdzogs rim nyams su blang bya la// sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// sbyor ba la yang thun mong dang*// thun mong min dang khyad par ro// thun mong chos la rnam bzhi ste// bde ba'i stan 'dug 'di ltar bsam// chos kun rgyu 'bras dkar nag 'bras// des bskyed 'khor ba myang 'das te// sngon bsags mi lus rnyed dka' ste// mi rtag 'chi ba myur du 'byung*// de phyir lam bzang 'tshol bar rigs// gnyis pa thun mong la'ang bzhi// 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i phyir// lus gnad chos bdun dang ldan par// mdun mkhar seng chen lnga tshom khrir// dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rdo rje 'chang dbang yab yum tshul// mdun du dpyid kyi rgyal mo dang*// g.yas su sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis// rgyab tu yum chen sher phyin ma// g.yon du byang sems 'dus pa'i tshogs// khri mtshams chos skyong srung mas bskor// mchod bstod skyabs sems rgyud 'dres bya// skyabs yul rang bstim de nyid bsgom// gnyis pa sgrib sbyong yig brgya'i khrid// spyi bor zla steng rdo rje sems// he ru ka dpal yab yum ni// yab dkar gcig shos byi ru'i mdog /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag brgyan// rdor dril gri thod 'dzin dmigs pa'i// yab kyi thugs kar zla steng hūm̐// de mthar yig brgya zla 'dras bskor// dzu ti'i don gnyis byas 'dus nas// bzlas pas sa bon sngags bcas las// rgyun bab sku gang mthe bong rgyud// tshangs bug nas zhugs lus gang bas// sdig sgrib dud mdog 'og sgor thon// rang lus shel ltar gyur dmigs bzlas// thun mthar lha bstim gnyug ma bsgom// gsum pa tshogs bsags maṇḍal ni// tshogs zhing skyabs yul rang gsal gdab// lus sogs ltos med maṇḍal 'bul// gsol btab dbyer med bstim zhing bsgom| |bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni// mdun du seng khrir rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/

/rdo rje 'chang dbang yab yum tshul gsal bar// brgyud pa'i tshogs kyi chu khur ltar 'khrigs bsam// mchod bstod mos gus drag po'i gsol btab tshe// sbyor mtshams kunda gnas bzhir 'phros// sad sogs sgrib sbyangs dbang bzhi thob// sku bzhi mngon byas rang la bstim// ngal gso tha mal shes par bya// thun rer skyabs 'gro brgya phrag gsum// yig brgya stong dang maṇḍal ni// brgya rtsa gsol 'debs mtshan sngags ni| |brgya phrag lnga lnga mkhas pas bya// gsum pa khyad par sngon 'gro ni// tha mal snang zhen bzlog thabs gsum// rtsa dang rlung bcas rnam lnga la// dang po lus gyi zhen zlog phyir/ rang lus dpyid kyi rgyal mo ni// lhan skyes yab yum gsal stong du// yun ring sgom zhing de yi mod// rnam gsal dag brtan nga rgyal brtan// gnyis pa nang gi zhen bzlog phyir// lha yi thugs kar nyi dkyil dbus// hūm̐ mthar sngags sgom spro bsdu ni// yab yum mkha' gsang bskor dmigs nas// yab yum snying po nye snying bzlas// gsum pa sems kyi zhen bzlog phyir// lha sngags snang grags stong pa'i ngang*// mnyam bzhag chu la ral gri ltar// rjes med ngang du yun bsring bsgom// bzhi pa rtsa la sbyang ba ni// rang nyid gong ltar lhar gsal ba'i// khong par dbu rkyang ro ma gsum// sngo dkar dmar ba dbu ma yi// yas sna gser mngal sgor zhugs shing*// ro rkyang yar sna klad rgya nas// 'gug pa sna bug la reg pa// rtsa gsum mar sna gsang gnas zug /ro rkyang cha ltar dbu mar tshud// spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis// mgrin par bcu drug snying khar brgyad// lte bar drug cu bzhi dang ni| |gsang bar chos 'byung gru gsum mo// phyi dkar nang dmar de kun kyang*// gsal drang phra grim bzhi ldan bsam// lnga pa rlung la sbyang ba ni// yon po srang ba zhal shes ltar| |byas rjes mkha' rlung rgyu ba'i tshe// sbyor ba bzhi ldan dbu mar bcing*// steng 'og bum pa kha sbyor bya// slar yang snang stong bsrubs shing gzhil// de sogs thun rer brgya rtsa brgyad// phan yon brjod 'das mkhas pas rtogs// gsum pa dngos gzhi dag la yang*// steng 'og rnam grol bde chen gnyis// dang po la yang rnam pa bzhi// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na// dang po phyi khrid 'di lta ste// rang nyid ye shes mgon po ni// tsa turhasta mngon rtogs ltar// gsal gdab dpral bar 'khor lo'i dbus// sku yi rdo rje dkar po ni// 'khor lo dril 'dzin rang 'od yum// sku yi rdo rje ma la 'khyud// de bzhin mgrin par padma'i dbus// gsung gi rdo rje padma dang*// dril bu 'dzin mar yum la 'khyud// snying khar rdo rje'i lte bar ru// thugs kyi rdo rje rdor dril 'dzin// sngon po rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud// mig tu gzugs kyi rdo rje dkar// rna bar sgra yi rdo rje mthing*// sna la dri yi rdo rje ser// lce la ro yi rdo rje dmar// tshigs kun reg bya rdo rje ljang*// yab rnams rdor dril 'khyud tshul dang*// yum rnams gri thod yab la sbyor// gnas gsum yum lnga'i lha rnams kun// yab yum rol stabs bzhengs tshul brgyan// cha lugs dpyid kyi rgyal mo ni// yab yum lhan skyes ji bzhin bsgom// de kun gnas gsum yi ges mtshan| |de ltar mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du// bskyed rim gsal snang thon par bsgom// slar yang mgon po'i thugs ka ru// nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags bskor ba// spro bsdu'i dmigs bcas bzlas pa bya// thun mthar rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni// go cha'i lha rnams 'od zhu ba// rang mdog thig le rang sar gnas// gtso bo stod smad 'od zhu ba// sa bon la thim sa bon la| |dar cig mnyam bzhag de nyid kyang*// 'od zhu dmigs med mnyam par bzhag

/de ltar mgon po gzhan bdun la'ang*// re re bzhin du mkhas par sbyangs// gnyis pa nang khrid bsgom pa ni// rang nyid dpyid kyi rgyal mo yi// khong nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo ni// sngar bzhin gsal btab spyi bo yi// rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis dbus// phyag bzhi mgon po yab yum ni// 'khril sbyor du bsam rtsa 'dab kun// rang mdog thig le re res brgyan// kha sbyor rlung sgom dmigs bsal tshe// 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge gsum// skye med rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya// mgon po yab yum bde sbyor mtshams// gsang mtshams dag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun// bab pas rtsa 'dab la rgyud nas// thig le so gnyis gang zhing rgyas| |thig le slar bcas bdud rtsi bab// mgrin pa yan gyi phyi nang kun// bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba'i tshe// sad pa'i sgrib dag bum dbang thob// sprul skur mngon byas mnyam par bzhag /slar yang thig le so gnyis po// mgon po la thim de nyid kyang*// 'od zhu hūm̐ gi rnam par byas// hūm̐ de mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud dbus// bab nas lhar bskyed tsha grang dang*// mnyam pa'i thig le dang bcas gsal// rlung dmigs sngar mtshungs bdud rtsi dmar// snying ga yan gang gsang dbang thob// rmi lam sgrib sbyangs longs skur smin// rdzogs rim byas la hūm̐ de nyid// snying khar bab pas lhar gsal zhing*// thig le brgyad dang bcas pa gsal// rlung sbyor la sogs sngar bzhin la// bdud rtsi sngon pos lte yan gang*// gnyid sgrib dag cing sher dbang thob// chos skur smin byas rdzogs rim gyis// hūm̐ 'di lte bar bab pa las// lhar gsal thig le so gnyis bsgom// rlung sbyor la sogs gong bzhin las// bdud rtsi ser po gsang yan gang*// 'pho ba'i sgrib sbyangs tshig dbang thob// chos skur smin byas rdzogs rim gyis// hūm̐ de gsang bar bab pa'i tshe// lhar gsal thig le gsum gyis bskor// rlung dmigs la sogs sngar ltar las// bdud rtsi lnga ldan mdog mtshungs bab// lus kun gang zhing sgo gsum gyi// rtogs tshogs sgrib sbyangs dbang lhag ma// kun thob ngo bo nyid sku 'grub// mgon po 'od zhu rang lus dang*// dbyer med ngang la mnyam nyid bsgom// de bzhin mgon po gzhan bdun yang*| |so sor re re gzhan dag tu// yab yum mnyam sbyor gnas lnga ru// bskyed cing dbab sogs rigs bsgres te// 'bad cing bsgoms pas smin grol gyi// yon tan gdan thog gcig tu smin// gsum pa gsang khrid 'di ltar sgom// rang nyid dpyid kyi rgyal mor bsgom// rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga gsal ba'i// spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis dbus// zla ba nya gang dkyil 'khor dbus// mgon po yab brgyad ngo bo nyid// haṃ yig dkar po thur bstan brgyad// gsang 'khor rtsa 'dab gru gsum dbus// 'od 'bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus| |mgon po yum brgyad ngo bo yi// gtum mo'i mtshan nyid bzhi ldan brgyad// gsal btab bum can rlung sbyor gyis// ro rkyang nang sbud gtum mor bsnun// ye shes shes rab yum gyi me// rab 'bar yab brgyad thabs kyi ngos// haṃ la reg tshe yab yum rnams// sbyor bde'i rnam pas haṃ brgyad las// bdud rtsi bab pas me lce dang*// 'bros 'ded tshul gyis mgrin par slebs/

/dga' ba'i ye shes ngo bo bltas// de bzhin snying khar mchog dga' dang*// lte bar dga' bral gsang ba ru// lhan skyes ngos gzung slar yang ni// gtum mo'i me sbar dkar cha ded// lugs ldog lte bar dga' ba dang*// snying gar mchog dga' mgrin pa ru// dga' bral spyi bor lhan skyes bsgom| |lugs 'byung lugs ldog gnyis ka la// gnas rer bum can bdun phrag re// slar yang bum can snang stong gi// sbyor bas gtum mo'i me sbar zhing*// haṃ las dkar cha bab pa dag /snying khar phrad cing 'dres pa rnams// gos la snum gyi bcud len ltar// rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga gang nas// lus kun khyab tshe mi bzod pa'i// bde ba dang bcas stong pa'i dngos// lhan skyes rang zhal de ru mthong*// de ltar 'bad de bsgom pa na// zung 'jug sku 'grub chos nyid yin// bzhi pa de bzhin nyid kyi khrid// gdod nas rang nyid lhar grub pa// log rtog gis bsgribs ma rtogs pa// de ltar rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i bye brag gis// gsal stong zung 'jug ngang du rtogs// de yang gnyis spangs dbu ma ni// bde chen byang chub mchog gi lam// thabs mchog dkar cha spyi bor haṃ// nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa// gsang gnas shes rab gtum mo'i me// thugs yum tsaṇḍi ka ru gnas// ro rkyang las kyi rlung rgyu nas// bya seng las mgon ngo bor gnas// mgon po gzhan bdun so so dang*// gcig dang du mar snang ba yang*// de nyid cho 'phrul rtsal las byung*// de kun rang sems ye shes mchog /gdod nas dag pa'i mgon po ste// gzhan du btsal med byar med pa// gdod ma'i mgon po nyid du rtogs// de nyid ngang la ma yeng bar// de yi ngo bo nyid sgom pa// ma byas byas min chos kyi gtso// kun byed rgyal po chos kyi sku// mgon po brgyad kyi ngo bo yin// gnyug ma'i lhan cig skyes pa'o| |gnyis pa 'og sgo bde chen khrid// sngon 'gro dang ni dngos gzhi gnyis// sngon 'gro rtsa rlung thig le gsum// sbyor tshul spyi dang 'dra bar bya// dngos gzhi la'ang rnam gnyis te| /rang lus tshag gzhug thabs ldan dang*// gzhan lus mnyam sbyor thabs ldan no// dang po rang lus lhar gsal bas// gnas lngar mgon po mched brgyad bskyed// yab yum thabs shes mnyam rol bsam// dang po las rlung rigs lnga yi// mnyam sbyor 'khril sbyor 'khrul 'khor bya// dbab skyil ldog 'grol man ngag ni// bde ba rtsal sbyangs gis dbab cing*// rtsa rlung thig gi gnas su bskyil/

/ka 'dzugs nywa bsgril dbang po rnams// gyen sgril thabs kyis rab ldog cing*// slar yang hūm̐ phaṭa ka 'jug gis| |sbyor ba drag pos drangs byas te// bum can bcu then rnam rol gyis// lus kun bde bas khyab par bkram// de la goms pa mchog thob nas// gnyis pa gzhan lus brten pa ni| |padma can sogs spyad 'os pa// dgug pa'i sbyor bas dbang bsdus nas// smin grol gyis btul las rung dang*// mkha' gsang byin rlabs yab yum gnyis// dpyid kyi rgyal mo yab yum bskyed// gnyis kar rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga// gsang ba'i yab gnas mgon brgyad yab// yum la yum rnams gsal byas te// bde sbyor srub pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis| |gnas kyi lha rnams mnyam sbyor bsam// 'du shes gsum ldan snyoms 'jug pa'i// bde bas myos tshe rang lus ltar// sbyor ba lnga yis nyams med bsrung*// bde stong lhan skyes ngang du gnas// de ltar goms pa lhur byas pa// 'chi med grub cing bde stong dag /lhan skyes zung 'jug go 'phang 'thob// gsum pa rjes la 'di lta ste// 'od gsal rmi lam sgyu lus dang*// bar do 'pho ba zhi rgyas dbang*// drag po dang ni rnam pa dgu// dang po 'od gsal bsgom pa ni// rang lus dpyid rgyal rtsa gsum dang*// 'khor lo lnga gsal snying ga ru// mgon po mched brgyad gsal btab cing*// 'od gsal zin par gsol ba btab// gtso bo'i thugs kar chu skyes mthing*// 'dab brgyad dbus su oṃ mthing dang*| |brgyad la badzra ma hā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭaḥ /gsal btab bder nyal 'dab ma yi// sngags la sems gtad rim bzhin bsgom// gnyid tshe oṃ la sems gtad pas// nyams dang srab mthug gnyid dang ni// mchog bcas 'od gsal rnam lnga po// bde blag nyid du zin par nges// gnyis pa rmi lam gdams pa ni// nyin snang rmi lam nyid du sbyang*// lhar gsal la sogs gong ltar las// snying ga'i rtsa 'dab mgon po brgyad// gsal btab gtso bo'i thugs ka ru// padma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i dbus// oṃ dang 'dab bzhi a dang nu| |ta ra bzhi spros ma yeng bar// nyal nas g.yas skor 'dab ma'i sngags// bzhi la sems bzung gnyid pa'i tshe// oṃ la sems gtad rmi lam zin// 'jam rtsub la sogs gang zin yang*// sprul sgyur sgyu mar sbyang bya zhing*// 'khrul pa'i bag chags bsal bar bya'o// gsum pa sgyu lus sbyang ba yang*// dag dang ma dag rnam pa gnyis| |dag pa bskyed rim rtsa 'khor lo// lhar bcas ma grub sgyu lus sku// rnam med rnam pa mchog ldan gnyis// ma dag 'khor ba'i sems can sogs// med bzhin snang ba sgyu ma'i dngos// nyin mtshan tshogs drug gang yin yang*/

/dngos med bden med sgyu mar sbyang*// bzhi pa bar do bsgom pa ni// drug dang bzhi sogs mang bshad kyang*// mdor bsdus myong ba lhur byed pa// goms 'dris 'phyug med bar dor bshad// nyin mtshan tshogs drug snang ba kun// bar dor sbyang zhing shar ba'i tshe// rig pa'i thim rim ngos bzung shing*| |lhag par snang mched thob pa'i rtags// dkar dmar nag po'i snang ba gsum// shar tshe ngos bzung dran med du// song ba shi bar sems pa'i ngang*// gzhi yi 'od gsal ngos bzung bya// ngos 'dzin don des bar dor grol// ngos ma zin na rmi lam rnams// bar do'i snang ba ngos bzung nas// de'i gdams pa spyi ltar bsgom// de ltar nyams su len pa'i tshe// bar chad tshe yi dus byed dam// 'gro ba gzhan la phan gdag phyir// drug pa 'pho ba'i gdams pa ni// rang lus dpyid rgyal rtsa 'khor gsal// sgo dgu dgag phyir mtshog mar oṃ// dpral bar badzra mig gnyis ma// sna bug hā dang rna bar kā// kha ru lā dang lte bar ya// gsang bar hūm̐ dang rkub tu phaṭa// mthing nag re res bkag par bsam// snying kha'i rtsa dbu pad dmar steng*// rang sems hūm̐ mthing 'od 'bar bsam// spyi bo'i bug thad ye shes mgon// 'od dpag med mgon dmar zhing gsal// khro 'dzum phyag bzhi dang po gnyis| |mnyam bzhag bum bcas tha ma zung*// rdor dril 'dzin pa gsal dmigs nas// mos gus gsol btab rlung gi gnad// pho rlung dgang 'gril hik gi sgras// skad cig bskul zhing thig le nyid// dpag med mgon po'i thugs kar bstim// zhing mchog de ru phyin pa yi// smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar nas// go 'phang mchog 'grub gdon mi za| /sbyong shing las la sbyar ba ni// 'pho ba gzhan ltar rnam dbye bya// drug pa zhi ba'i las bsgrub ni// rang nyid dpyid kyi rgyal mor bsgom// rtsa gsum 'khor lo dang bcas dkar// spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab dbus dag tu// mgon po mched brgyad dung ltar dkar// rtsa phyag rnams su g.yas rdo rje// g.yon pa shel bum bdud rtsis bkang*// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ sngags bcas// 'dzab bzlas 'od dkar 'phros pa yis// rgyal mchod 'gro drug sgrib sbyangs shing*// rang gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams// dri ma chus bkrus ltar dag bsam// sngags mthar shāntiṃ ku ru dag

*/khyad par las mtha' so sor bsgyur// bdun pa rgyas pa'i las bsgrub ni// rtsa 'khor mgon po dang bcas ser// g.yas pa rin chen g.yon ne'u le// thugs kar nyi steng sngags 'khor bsam// 'od kyis rgyas pa'i las sgrub cing*// bye brag las sbyor so sor bsgyur// brgyad pa dbang gi las sbyor ni// rtsa 'khor lhar bcas dmar po la// g.yas pa lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa// thugs kar zla steng sngags 'khor spros// skabs bab las sbyor gang 'dod bsgyur/ */dgu pa drag po bsgrub pa ni// rtsa 'khor lhar bcas mthing nag mdog /g.yas rnams ral gri g.yon thod khrag /thugs kar nyi steng sngags bcas bskor// las sgrub skabs bab dmigs pa bsgyur// shāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ wa shyaṃ ya| |mā ra ya dang swā hā dang*/ oṃ he phaṭa bcas sngags sham gdags// zhal phyag gsum bzhi drug la sogs// rtsa ba'i zhal phyag las mthun bsgyur// lhag ma rang so rig mdas bsnun| |chas rgyan las kyi skabs bstun bya// de ltar sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis// nag po brgyad kyi rdzogs rim rnams// rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshigs rkang rdzogs// sngon 'gro'i zhib cha bsags sbyang dang*// bskyed rim rlung gnad sbyang ba gsum// dngos gzhi steng 'og sgo gnyis chos// lus ngag yid gsum dmigs med rlung*// bskyed rdzogs la sogs gnad mang zhing*| |mjug tu chos lnga las bzhi la// bye brag so so'i skabs bab kyis// dmigs bsgyur gnad kyi man ngag dang*// so so'i zhib cha rnam mang po// dam kha ba yi lhun po che// rab bskrun nyi 'od kyis bskul pa'i// gsung gi nyal 'gro gang bab pa'i// dad ldan yid bum las gzhol gyi// dad dang dam tshig mi bsrung bar/ /kha mkhas snying khrel la sems pa| |snod kyi skyon gsum dang ldan rnams// smin grol bdud rtsis tshim pa bas// srung ma rnams kyis tshar chod cig /de ltar rdzogs pa'i rim pa mchog

/tshig nyung don mang mdo sngags kyi// gnad kun bsdus pa'i legs bshad ni/ */rdo rje'i tshig rkang mchog 'di ko/ */dad ldan 'ga' la phan pa'i blos/ sa khams bum sna can gyi lo'i// gro zhun zla ba'i phyogs snga ma// stong pa dang por 'bri gung pa// dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ming*// chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas// lhag bsam dkar pos sbyar ba'i dges// thub bstan bltas shing 'gro ba kun// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog// /maṅga laṃ/
